# Wave 3a Four-Way Performance Benchmark Report (MESA `r26.4.1`)

!!! info "Raw Capture Provenance (`benchmarks/raw/26.4.1/`, `#146`)"
    Measured offline against MESA `r26.4.1` (`fortran_wave3a.txt`, `rust_waves_1_to_5.txt`, `python_waves_1_to_5.json`). All four workloads call compiled MESA `r26.4.1` `eosDT_get_component` routines in every Fortran stage.

## 3. Key Wave 3a Findings ($N_{\mathrm{zones}} = 4096$)

1. **`eos_helm` & analytical EOS throughput**: At 4096 zones and 4 threads, Safe Rust evaluates `eos_helm` in `552.04 us` vs. `2250.11 us` in MESA (`4.08x`).
2. **`eos_skye` warm speed vs. XLA compile cost**: Warm GPU `@jax.jit(jax.vmap)` evaluates `eos_skye` in `4202.59 us` per profile vs. `9525.61 us` in 4t Safe Rust and `16540.28 us` in 4t MESA (`3.94x`), at the cost of `60668.4 ms` first-call XLA compilation.
